metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: FUPDIG crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C66 H80 Cl6 Cu4 N16 O28 Tb4 2+,15(H2 O1),2(Cl1 1-). From the CIF bond table, Tb2 (Tb) has 7 O neighbors; Tb1 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Cu2 (Cu) has 1 O neighbors; Cu1 (Cu) has 0 O neighbors; Tb3 (Tb) has 7 O neighbors; Tb4 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Cu3 (Cu) has 1 O neighbors; Cu4 (Cu) has 0 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 5 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.936-4.098 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 111.36-117.16°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Cu4Tb4L4Cl6(CH3OH)2(H2O)10]Cl2(H2O)x (Cu4Tb4C66H84N16O43Cl8). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 10 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 10 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
